task.instructions: Set up the device-free Hamilton STAR deck, move 100 microliters from the source container to the target with one standard channel, return the tip, inspect resulting state, and stop the liquid handler.
success_criteria: The source loses exactly 100 microliters and the target gains exactly 100 microliters.
The selected tip is returned to its original spot with no liquid remaining on a channel.
The liquid handler reaches the stopped state after every selected operation family is exercised.
No invalid or denied operation occurs.
task.title: Execute a device-free Hamilton STAR transfer
